title: Niloticin binds to MD-2 to promote anti-inflammatory pathway activation in macrophage cells.
authors: Chen, Guirong; Liu, Chang; Zhang, Mingbo; Wang, Xiaobo; Xu, Yubin
journal: International journal of immunopathology and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物niloticin与MD-2蛋白的结合及抗炎机制，虽涉及分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Niloticin is an active compound isolated from Cortex phellodendri with uncharacterized anti-inflammatory activity. We assessed the drug potential of niloticin and examined its ability to target myeloid differentiation protein 2 (MD-2) to ascertain the mechanism for its anti-inflammatory activity. METHODS: The Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database was used to evaluate niloticin. Bio-layer interferometry and molecular docking technologies were used to explore how niloticin targets MD-2, which mediates a series of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)-dependent inflammatory responses. The cytokines involved in the lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB pathway were evaluated using ELISA, RT-qPCR, and western blotting. RESULTS: Niloticin could bind to MD-2 and had no evident effects on cell viability. Niloticin treatment significantly decreased the levels of NO, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta induced by LPS (p < 0.01). IL-1beta, IL-6, iNOS, TNF-alpha, and COX-2 mRNA expression levels were decreased by niloticin (all p < 0.01). Compared with that in the control group, the increase in TLR4, p65, MyD88, p-p65, and iNOS expression levels induced by LPS were suppressed by niloticin (all p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: Our results suggest that niloticin has therapeutic potential and binds to MD-2. Niloticin binding to MD-2 antagonized the effects of LPS binding to the TLR4/MD-2 complex, resulting in the inhibition of the LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：Niloticin是从黄柏中分离得到的一种活性化合物，其抗炎活性尚未明确。我们评估了niloticin的药物潜力，并考察其靶向髓系分化蛋白2（MD-2）的能力，以确定其抗炎活性的机制。方法：使用中药系统药理学数据库评估niloticin。采用生物层干涉技术和分子对接技术探讨niloticin如何靶向MD-2，后者介导一系列Toll样受体4（TLR4）依赖性炎症反应。通过ELISA、RT-qPCR和western blotting评估脂多糖（LPS）-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB通路中涉及的细胞因子。结果：Niloticin能够结合MD-2，且对细胞活力无明显影响。Niloticin处理显著降低了LPS诱导的NO、IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β水平（p < 0.01）。Niloticin降低了IL-1β、IL-6、iNOS、TNF-α和COX-2 mRNA表达水平（均p < 0.01）。与对照组相比，LPS诱导的TLR4、p65、MyD88、p-p65和iNOS表达水平的升高被niloticin抑制（均p < 0.01）。结论：我们的结果表明，niloticin具有治疗潜力并能结合MD-2。Niloticin与MD-2的结合拮抗了LPS与TLR4/MD-2复合物的结合效应，从而抑制LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB信号通路。
